Bright fog fills the ravines where a dark, uneven rocky plateau falls sharply away along several edges. Barren rolling ridges lie beyond, beneath a dim blue-gray, faintly starry sky. On the plateau, roughly eight to ten rusted metal structures gather in a loose, organic oval around a broad empty central yard.

The largest tiered furnace complex anchors one end. Several smaller cylindrical workshops, squat drum-like buildings, and tall chimney towers wrap the other sides, making the perimeter moderately dense but leaving irregular gaps and an open center rather than streets or rows. Heavy circular bases, stacked bands, domed or flat roofs, narrow catwalk rails, pipes, cables, and round openings give the structures their industrial form. Occasional warm orange light leaks from seams and doorways; several smokestacks release thin pale smoke.

Mottled, damp-looking charcoal-green earth carries shallow ruts, patches of mist, scattered puddle-like marks, and isolated pale boulders. A rough arc of larger rocks follows part of the settlement. A few small triangular sheet-metal awnings, cables linking buildings, and sparse post-like objects near the outskirts complete the bleak, misty scene.
